name.ja: Figure-rise Standard 超サイヤ人ゴッド超サイヤ人孫悟空
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan Son Goku

ja: TVアニメ『ドラゴンボール超』に登場の超サイヤ人ゴッド超サイヤ人孫悟空がパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！マッスルをビルドせよ！
• 超サイヤ人ゴッド超サイヤ人の特徴の青く輝く頭髪はメタリックの成形色で再現！
• 表情パーツには「平常」・「叫び」の２種類が付属。
• エフェクトパーツには「かめはめ波(ため)」と「かめはめ波(解放)」の２種が付属。
• 劇中内で着用する胴着の「悟」マークを再現するホイルシールが付属。
en: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan Son Goku from the TV anime “Dragon Ball Super” has been released with a renewed package! ! Build muscle!
• Super Saiyan God The shining blue hair that characterizes Super Saiyan is reproduced in metallic molding color!
• Two types of expression parts are included: "normal " and " screaming".
• Two types of effect parts are included: "Kamehameha (Tame)" and " Kamehameha (Release)".
• Comes with a foil seal that reproduces the "Satoru" mark on the body worn in the play.

ja: 必殺技エフェクト2種（かめはめ波〈ため〉、かめはめ波〈解放〉）×各1
表情パーツ2種（平常、叫び）×各1
手首パーツ5種（左右握り手、左右かめはめ波手、瞬間移動手）×各1
en: 2 types of special move effects (Kamehameha (Tame), Kamehameha (Release)) x 1 each
2 types of facial expression parts (normal, screaming) x 1 each
5 types of wrist parts (left and right grip hands, left and right Kamehameha hands, teleportation hands) x 1 each
